# Spending triggers

## Money spent

Runs every time someone spends money on your stream: a tip, Super Chat, Super Sticker, rant, bits, Kicks, Jewels, a subscription, gift subs or a shop order. The amount is already changed into your chosen currency. Good for thanking big spenders or showing a running total.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Platform** | Only for this platform, like Twitch or Ko-fi. Leave it empty for every platform. |
| **Minimum amount (your currency)** | Only when the purchase is worth at least this much, in your chosen currency. 0 = every purchase. Starts as: `0`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%user%` | Who spent the money |
| `%platform%` | Where they spent it, like Twitch, YouTube, Kick, Rumble, Streamlabs or Ko-fi |
| `%label%` | What it was, like Cheer, Super Chat, Rant, Subscription or Gift subs |
| `%amount%` | What it is worth, in your chosen currency, like 4.99 |
| `%currency%` | Your chosen currency, like USD |
| `%formattedAmount%` | The amount with its currency sign, like $4.99 |
| `%paidAmount%` | What they actually paid: the money in their own currency, or the number of bits, Kicks, Jewels or subs |
| `%paidCurrency%` | The currency they paid in, like EUR, or Bits, Kicks, Jewels, Subscription or GiftSubscription |
| `%streamTotal%` | Everything this person has spent this stream on that platform, in your currency |
| `%rank%` | Their place on this stream's top spenders list (1 = the top spender) |
| `%sessionId%` | The stream's internal id |

<small>Type id: `spending.recorded`</small>

## New top spender this stream

Runs when somebody new becomes the top spender of this stream. Good for a "new top spender!" alert or chat message.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **List** | Which list. All platforms = the top spender across every platform changed. A platform name like Twitch = the top spender on that platform changed. Any = either. Starts as: `All platforms`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%user%` | The new top spender |
| `%platform%` | Their platform |
| `%total%` | Everything they have spent this stream, in your chosen currency |
| `%currency%` | Your chosen currency, like USD |
| `%formattedTotal%` | The total with its currency sign, like $25.00 |
| `%previousUser%` | Who was the top spender before (empty when nobody was) |
| `%previousPlatform%` | The platform of the previous top spender |
| `%previousTotal%` | What the previous top spender had spent |
| `%scope%` | Which list changed: All platforms, or the platform's name |

<small>Type id: `spending.topSpenderChanged`</small>
